title: Severe Thanksgiving storms leave roads flooded and trees fallen
summary: Hundreds of thousands of people were without power after severe weather hit both coasts of the United States during the Thanksgiving holiday.

blocks.text: Both US coasts have been battered by severe Thanksgiving storms, leaving behind flooded roads, fallen trees, and widespread power outages for hundreds of thousands of people.
Although the weather is expected to improve, hundreds of flights remain delayed or cancelled on Friday.
Beyond the travel disruption, impacts were widespread across the east Coast, and US President Donald Trump said he would consider releasing emergency funds.
